title: TraceQual Schema v1.1
description: JSON Schema for TraceQual's decision matrix and positioning log. One decision matrix row per substantive AI suggestion (not per turn or per session). See docs/schema_notes.md for column rationale and methods citations.
methods_anchors: McDonald, Schoenebeck, and Forte (2019) — audit trail without IRR reporting
Braun and Clarke (2006, 2022) — analytic_stage phase enum

decision_enum.description: Researcher response to a substantive AI suggestion. accepted: used substantially as-given (light formatting edits do not count as modified). modified: substance changed in ways that affect analytic meaning. rejected: explicitly not used or contradicted by subsequent direction. deferred: set aside without accept/reject. unclear: transcript does not show what happened next.

analytic_stage_enum.description: Braun and Clarke reflexive thematic analysis phase. Use coding when ambiguous.

confidence_enum.description: Extractor confidence in row accuracy. high: explicit decision and reasoning in transcript. medium: explicit decision, inferred reasoning. low: inferred decision or reasoning, or ambiguous transcript; prefix inferred reasoning with [inferred].

shift_type_enum.description: Epistemic stance shift type for the positioning pass. broadening/narrowing: scope shifts. reframing: change in conceptual lens. reaffirming: pushback that strengthens existing frame. destabilizing: AI suggestion produced genuine uncertainty about a prior commitment.

decision_row.description: One row in the primary decision matrix.

turn_id.description: Sequential turn index within the chat session. Used for ordering; not a timestamp.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 datetime when present in the export format; null for pasted transcripts.

researcher_prompt_summary.description: One-sentence neutral summary of what the researcher asked.

ai_suggestion_summary.description: One-sentence neutral summary of what the AI proposed.

reasoning.description: Researcher's stated or inferred rationale. Prefix with [inferred] when reasoning is inferred.

decision_stated.description: True when the researcher's decision is directly observable in the transcript; false when inferred.

reasoning_stated.description: True when the researcher's reasoning is explicitly stated in the transcript; false when inferred.

positioning_row.description: One row in the secondary positioning log.

turn_id.description: Anchor turn in the main decision matrix.

evidence_quote.description: Verbatim excerpt from the researcher's turn, under 15 words.

note.description: One-sentence interpretation of the stance shift.

decision_matrix.description: Primary extraction output: structured record of researcher analytic decisions.

positioning_log.description: Secondary positioning pass output: sparse log of epistemic stance shifts.
